findings.issue: The app ships no test script, no runner, and zero tests, despite ~590 lines of source heavy in data transformation
findings.suggestion: Add a lightweight runner (e.g. node:test or vitest) with unit tests for the pure helpers and data loaders; wire a `test` script into package.json

findings.issue: loadResults (search, type/generation filter, 48-per-page slice, page clamping) is the highest-risk logic in the app and is untested
findings.suggestion: Table-driven unit tests over fixture DexEntry arrays: boundary pages (0/47/48/49 matches), page beyond total, filter combinations

findings.issue: parseHomeQuery/homeUrl implement the URL-state contract with no tests; garbage or default params silently regressing would break deep links and the address bar
findings.suggestion: Property-style round-trip tests: parse(homeUrl(q)) === canonical q, plus edge inputs page=abc, page=0, page=-1, empty q

findings.issue: Stale-while-revalidate cache plus concurrency semaphore is subtle async code (pending dedupe, error cleanup, LRU eviction) with no deterministic test
findings.suggestion: Unit tests with a stubbed fetch and fake timers covering: stale-entry background refresh, error during refresh, concurrent get() dedupe, eviction at MAX_ENTRIES

findings.issue: htmx contract (isHtmx sniffing, HX-Push-Url with clamped page, Vary: HX-Request) untested; a refactor could serve a fragment as a full document or push a non-canonical URL
findings.suggestion: Route-level tests using app.request() asserting status, HX-Push-Url header and fragment-vs-document body for HX-Request: true/false

findings.issue: Client-side sort's missing-values-last-in-both-directions rule and aria-sort toggling have no coverage; `cmp * sign` alone would flip missing rows to first on descending
findings.suggestion: DOM-level tests (happy-dom or Playwright component test) for ascending/descending/missing-value ordering

findings.issue: Moves-table grouping, (name, level) dedupe, method ordering and default sort are spec-critical and untested
findings.suggestion: Unit tests over fixture pokemon.moves covering method order (level-up/machine/egg/tutor then alphabetical), dedupe, and level-then-name sort

findings.issue: speciesForPokemon's alternate-form exclusion and first-reference-wins `extra` (used for the hidden-ability badge) is an implicit invariant no test pins
findings.suggestion: Unit test with refs including an id > 10000 form and duplicate species entries asserting exclusion and which extra survives

summary: The app contains no tests of its own — no test script, no runner, zero assertions — leaving ~590 lines of filter/pagination, URL-state, caching and sorting logic guarded only by the external acceptance suite. Most of the risky logic is exported, pure, and trivially testable, so the omission is a choice, not a constraint. Any future refactor of app/src/api.ts or the home-page query handling would land unverified.
